viewing_check: Smell and look at the cut ends: genuine Huon pine has a strong distinctive oily/sweet scent, tight fine growth rings and a pale yellow colour; celery top has a plainer smell. Check slab thickness and length, and whether the knots/void are structural. The stained void slab is worth less.
